description:
Design a 3-bladed wind turbine rotor (Radius = 2m) with a LINEAR taper (straight edges) and linear twist distribution. The goal is to match a specific operating point: the rotor must achieve its Maximum Power Coefficient (Max Cp) at a Tip Speed Ratio (TSR) of 7.0 (±0.2). 

Steps:
1. Generate a NACA 4412 airfoil, run XFoil analysis (Re=500,000, Ncrit=9), and extrapolate the polar to 360 degrees.
2. Create a new blade/rotor (R=2m, Hub=0.2m, 3 blades).
3. Adjust the Chord and Twist distributions to be LINEAR (do not use Betz/Schmitz optimization curves directly). 
4. Run BEM TSR sweep simulations (range 3-10) to determine the peak performance point.
5. Iteratively adjust the linear chord/twist slopes until the Peak Cp occurs at TSR 7.0.
6. Save the project to '~/Documents/projects/tsr7_rotor.wpa'.
7. Export the final blade geometry to '~/Documents/tsr7_geometry.txt' (Blade Design -> Export -> Geometry to .txt).
8. Export the simulation results to '~/Documents/tsr7_bem_results.txt' (Simulation View -> Export).
